name: open-fitness
description: OpenFitness: an open-source fitness platform for agents and native clients.

scripts.apple:generate: python3 scripts/generate-apple-project.py && xcrun --sdk macosx swift scripts/generate-app-icons.swift
scripts.apple:format: swift format format --in-place --recursive apps/ios/OpenFitness apps/ios/OpenFitnessWatch apps/ios/OpenFitnessUITests packages/OpenFitnessKit
scripts.apple:lint: swift format lint --strict --recursive apps/ios/OpenFitness apps/ios/OpenFitnessWatch apps/ios/OpenFitnessUITests packages/OpenFitnessKit/Sources packages/OpenFitnessKit/Tests packages/OpenFitnessKit/Package.swift
scripts.apple:build: xcodebuild -quiet -project apps/ios/OpenFitness.xcodeproj -scheme OpenFitness -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath apps/ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES build
